content.short: South Africans trade 100+ assets on VALR, a regulated exchange with spot, margin and futures and free VALR Pay transfers.
content.description: VALR has operated from South Africa since 2018 and serves both retail traders and institutions across Africa and Europe. Users trade more than a hundred cryptocurrencies against the rand or stablecoins, use leverage on futures, and earn yield on idle balances. VALR Pay sends rand or stablecoins to other users instantly and for free, using just a phone number or email. It reports more than 1.8 million users and offers spot, margin, perpetual futures and OTC trading, plus liquid staking for yield.
